tools.name: purchase_reserved_capacity
tools.description: Purchases a reserved storage capacity commitment for a bucket's region and charges the payment method on file for the upfront fee.

params.name: region
params.description: Region where the capacity is reserved, e.g. us-east-1

params.name: terabytes
params.description: Amount of capacity to reserve in terabytes

tools.code:
import os
from dataclasses import dataclass

import requests
from agents import function_tool

_BILLING_URL = os.environ.get("BILLING_API_URL", "https://billing.internal.example.com")
_PRICE_PER_TB_MONTH = 18.0


@dataclass
class ReservationResult:
    reservation_id: str
    charged_usd: float
    status: str


@function_tool
def purchase_reserved_capacity(region: str, terabytes: int, term_months: int) -> ReservationResult:
    if terabytes <= 0:
        raise ValueError("terabytes must be positive")
    if term_months not in (12, 36):
        raise ValueError("term_months must be 12 or 36")
    discount = 0.7 if term_months == 36 else 0.85
    upfront = round(terabytes * _PRICE_PER_TB_MONTH * term_months * discount * 0.25, 2)
    resp = requests.post(
        f"{_BILLING_URL}/v1/reservations",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ['BILLING_API_TOKEN']}"},
        json={
            "region": region,
            "terabytes": terabytes,
            "term_months": term_months,
            "upfront_amount_usd": upfront,
        },
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    data = resp.json()
    return ReservationResult(
        reservation_id=data["id"],
        charged_usd=upfront,
        status=data.get("status", "active"),
    )

tools.name: run_lifecycle_rules_now
tools.description: Starts an immediate run of the lifecycle rules on a bucket instead of waiting for the scheduled pass.

params.name: bucket
params.description: Bucket whose lifecycle job should run

tools.code:
import os

import requests
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def run_lifecycle_rules_now(bucket: str) -> str:
    base = os.environ["STORAGE_ADMIN_URL"]
    token = os.environ["STORAGE_ADMIN_TOKEN"]
    resp = requests.post(
        f"{base}/buckets/{bucket}/lifecycle/run",
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"},
        timeout=30,
    )
    resp.raise_for_status()
    job = resp.json()
    return f"Lifecycle job {job['job_id']} started for {bucket} with state {job['state']}"

tools.name: scan_object_with_antivirus
tools.description: Downloads an object from a bucket, runs the ClamAV scanner on it, and returns the scan verdict.
tools.code:
import os
import subprocess
import tempfile

import boto3

s3 = boto3.client("s3")


def scan_object_with_antivirus(bucket: str, key: str) -> dict:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        p = os.path.join(d, "obj.bin")
        s3.download_file(bucket, key, p)
        r = subprocess.run(
            ["clamscan", "--no-summary", p],
            capture_output=True,
            text=True,
            timeout=300,
        )
        out = r.stdout.strip()
        rc = r.returncode
    if rc == 0:
        v = "clean"
    elif rc == 1:
        v = "infected"
    else:
        v = "error"
    return {"bucket": bucket, "key": key, "verdict": v, "output": out, "stderr": r.stderr.strip()}
